description: Fantastic opportunity!18100 Burbank Blvd. #26, a spacious, completely renovated and beautifully reimagined tri-level interior-facing townhome located in the highly sought-after "Lindley Townhome"  community of Tarzana. This move-in-ready residence delivers an exceptional combination of size, comfort, and location with approximately 2,112 sq. ft. of updated living space, 3 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and an attached 2-car garage.  As you enter the main level, you are greeted by a bright and inviting living room featuring a cozy fireplace, soaring ceilings, and abundant natural light. The formal dining area flows seamlessly into the updated kitchen, complete with newer stainless steel appliances and a center sink island, a breakfast nook, and an additional casual living/dining area — creating an ideal layout for both everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite serves as a true retreat with three closets and a spacious, updated en-suite bathroom with dual sinks. A second upstairs bedroom also features a private updated en-suite bath, offering additional comfort and privacy. The lower level includes a third bedroom with its own bathroom, along with direct access to the garage and laundry area. Outside, enjoy a charming front patio space perfect for relaxing or dining outdoors. This gated community offers tranquil ponds, picnic areas, including a sparkling pool, relaxing spa/jacuzzi, and inviting outdoor lounging areas — providing a peaceful setting for resort-style living. HOA dues conveniently cover exterior maintenance of amenities, including pool & spa, water, refuse disposal and earthquake insurance. With impressive square footage, desirable amenities, and offering the best values per square foot among private garage townhomes in Tarzana. This wonderful townhome is for the buyers that “want it all”!
